title: Typing Props
description: Learn patterns for typing component props effectively.

data.text: Props are the primary way to pass data to components. TypeScript ensures you pass the right types and catch errors early.

Children Prop

terms.definition: Union type representing anything renderable in React
The return type of JSX expressions
A pattern where a component receives a function as a prop

data.title: ReactNode vs JSX.Element
data.text: ReactNode is more permissive - it accepts strings, numbers, arrays, etc. JSX.Element is more strict - only accepts JSX.

data.title: Exercise: Type a Modal Component
data.description: Create a Modal component with typed props including children, onClose, and isOpen.
steps: Add optional title and size props
data.expectedOutcome: A fully typed Modal component with sensible defaults and optional props.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use union types for limited options
Render props are functions that return ReactNode
data.takeaway: Well-typed props make components safe and easy to use.
